Checking the numbers: opponents p1 and p4 are nearly broke so they'd just go bankrupt rather than cost me much, while p3 with $381 is the real risk. Rent jumps from 2 to 3 houses on Virginia (180→500) look like the best payoff, and I can still sell a house for half value if income tax or a bad landing hits — building one house on Virginia feels like the right moderate-risk move.
